what: The plan removes the Step 17 token-report chat tail but leaves the Step 18 write-final-report.sh --print-stdout path unaddressed.
scenario_or_breakage: Step 17 prints the final summary cost line, then Step 18 prints the rendered final summary again, so /implement still has duplicate chat-side cost emission despite the stated single-emission invariant.
suggested_fix: Update the plan to change the Step 18 write-final-report call to run without --print-stdout or capture/redirect stdout while preserving the comment/log refresh, and add a structure test that Step 18 does not print the final summary block.

what: Rendering and upserting the /design final summary before design-log-publish means later publish failures cannot be reflected in the summary.
scenario_or_breakage: If design-log-publish fails, execution-issues.md gets a warning after the summary was rendered/upserted, so Warnings stays stale and the comment can advertise larch-logs/design/<RUN_ID>/ even though the log publish did not land.
suggested_fix: Make the helper support a local render before publish for final-summary.md, then re-render/upsert/print after the publish attempt and after any publish warning is appended; or otherwise defer chat/upsert until all Step 5c warning-producing work is complete.

what: The plan adds skills/design/scripts/test-render-final-summary.sh and its .md sibling but does not update agent-lint exclusions for Makefile-only design harnesses.
scenario_or_breakage: agent-lint --pedantic is run by pre-commit, and this config already excludes analogous Makefile-only design test scripts and sibling docs; the new harness can be flagged as dead/orphaned even if the Makefile target exists.
suggested_fix: Add skills/design/scripts/test-render-final-summary.sh near the design test-script exclusions and skills/design/scripts/test-render-final-summary.md near the design test-*.md sibling exclusions.

what: The plan changes cost-line ownership but misses existing contract docs that still describe token-report --summary and render-cost-line.sh as dollar-line surfaces.
scenario_or_breakage: Operators and future contributors will still be told to print token-report.sh --summary verbatim, that render-cost-line.sh is the /design terminal caller, and that harnesses pin the old dollar-primary summary behavior, undermining the new single-source invariant.
suggested_fix: Update these docs alongside the code: token-report.md should describe summary without a dollar line, token-cost/render-cost-line docs should mark render-cost-line as standalone/deprecated for runtime callers, and docs/linting.md should describe the revised harness expectations plus the new test-render-final-summary target.
